profile.name: 蠕动泵
profile.description: 这是一种实验室蠕动泵，通过滚轮挤压软管实现连续、低脉动的液体输送。它常用于培养基、缓冲液、试剂或废液的定量输送与循环，在微流控、细胞培养、灌流和一般流体处理实验中常见。
profile.description_en: This is a laboratory peristaltic pump that moves liquid by compressing flexible tubing with rotating rollers, enabling continuous and relatively low-pulsation flow. It is commonly used for metered transfer or circulation of media, buffers, reagents, and waste in microfluidics, cell culture, perfusion, and general fluid-handling experiments.
